crossRefs.note: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in…
You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and…
They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

translations.web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
translations.bsb: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
translations.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
translations.asv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?
